candidate_sentence_map.S1: Tallinna Vesi Group delivered stronger financial results in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue rose 11.4% to €72.48 million, from €65.08 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Water-services revenue increased 6.9% to €62.31 million, while construction-services revenue grew 62.0% to €8.46 million, supported by higher pipe-construction and external road-construction activity.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Revenue from private customers in the main service area increased 18.3% to €31.84 million, reflecting higher consumption and tariff changes.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Business-customer revenue declined 2.7% to €16.76 million, mainly because business tariffs were reduced as part of the statutory harmonisation of private and business prices.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Revenue from customers outside the main service area increased 13.8% to €7.71 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Stormwater and fire-hydrant service revenue fell 25.5% to €4.35 million, largely because revised pricing rules changed the classification of combined-sewer-system revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Cost of goods and services sold increased 12.0% to €42.96 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Direct production costs were broadly unchanged at €9.90 million: lower purchased electricity costs, resulting partly from the new combined heat and power plant, largely offset higher chemical and pollution-tax expenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Other costs increased 16.0%, including a 6.8% rise in staff costs and a 74.5% increase in construction-services costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Despite the cost growth, gross profit increased 10.5% to €29.52 million, EBITDA rose to €30.95 million from €27.51 million, and operating profit increased 11.8% to €21.22 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company attributed the operating-profit improvement mainly to electricity-cost optimisation following the launch of the combined heat and power plant.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Net financial expense declined to €3.78 million from €4.20 million, mainly due to lower Euribor rates.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Profit before tax increased 18.0% to €17.43 million, while net profit rose 7.2% to €14.24 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Net profit growth was moderated by the higher income-tax rate on dividend payments.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Earnings per share increased from €0.66 to €0.71, although the net profit margin declined from 20.41% to 19.69%.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Investment remained a major feature of the period.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: The Group invested €55.74 million in fixed assets, above the previous year, and operating cash flow increased to €30.83 million from €26.25 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Cash at year-end rose to €11.29 million from €3.59 million, supported by €45 million of new borrowing, while total borrowings increased to €161.4 million and the debt-to-assets ratio rose to 66.02% from 61.71%.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Operationally, the company advanced major network, stormwater and treatment-plant projects.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: It laid or reconstructed 45.1 kilometres of pipes, expanded smart-meter coverage to more than 80% of customers, and commissioned combined heat and power generation that produced all required treatment-plant heat and 43.8% of relevant electricity consumption.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Water and wastewater quality remained high, while sewer blockages declined to 363 from 441.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The Group’s financial statements received an unmodified auditor’s opinion.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K6 are fully represented with supporting sentences. K5 is missing entirely (no mention of drinking water quality compliance, Green Company award, stormwater systems, or climate targets). K7 is missing (no dividend policy details). K8 is missing (no 2026 strategic priorities). The summary captures most high-importance financial and operational highlights but omits key strategic and sustainability elements, resulting in a Generally yes rating.
